title: Fixed ends allow only some frequencies
caption: With both ends fixed, only whole numbers of half-wavelengths fit: λₙ = 2L/n. For L = 0.65 m and v = 420 m s⁻¹, f = nv/(2L) gives 323 Hz, 646 Hz, 969 Hz for the first three modes.
alt: Three standing waves on a 0.65 metre string fixed at both ends with one, two and three half-wavelengths, at 323, 646, 969 hertz.
description: A string of length 0.65 m fixed at both ends, wave speed 420 m s⁻¹.
Mode 1: half a wavelength fits, λ = 2L = 1.3 m, f = 420/1.3 = 323 Hz.
Mode 2: one wavelength fits, λ = L = 0.65 m, f = 646 Hz, with a node in the middle.
Mode 3: λ = 2L/3 = 0.433 m, f = 969 Hz. Frequencies between these cannot satisfy the boundary conditions.
